description: Metadata-only inventory of Dev Ledger credentials and non-secret configuration. Contains NO secret values — names and classification only. The test suite derives the browser-forbidden deny list from this file; keep it in sync with docs/secret-rotation.md.

secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.purpose: iron-session cookie seal key — encrypts the session payload including sid and leaseUntil
secrets.rotationImpact: all existing sessions unseal-fail — every user must sign in again

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.purpose: server-side Supabase credential — bypasses RLS for sync writes, session lookup, security_events inserts
secrets.rotationImpact: all database access fails if the key is wrong — zero session/user impact

secrets.name: GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.purpose: OAuth token exchange at /api/auth/callback (code → user access token)
secrets.rotationImpact: new sign-ins fail at token exchange — existing sealed sessions unaffected

secrets.name: GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.purpose: signs JWTs to mint GitHub App installation access tokens for sync/webhook ingest
secrets.rotationImpact: GitHub App authentication fails — sync and webhook ingest stop; sign-in unaffected

secrets.name: GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.purpose: HMAC verification of X-Hub-Signature-256 on /api/webhooks/github deliveries
secrets.storage: Vercel environment variable (Production) + GitHub App webhook settings
secrets.rotationImpact: single secret on both sides — deliveries between the two updates are rejected and retried by GitHub

secrets.name: CRON_SECRET
secrets.purpose: bearer token Vercel attaches to /api/cron/sync invocations; endpoint compares it to the env value
secrets.rotationImpact: atomic per deployment — Vercel sends the same env value the function reads; cron 401s only if the two ever diverge

secrets.name: SECURITY_EVENT_HASH_KEY
secrets.purpose: dedicated HMAC-SHA256 key for actor_hash/source_hash correlation in security_events
secrets.rotationImpact: future events hash under the new key — cannot correlate with rows hashed under the old key; ≤30-day retention window keeps old-hash rows; no app availability impact

secrets.name: SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: Postgres password for npm run db:migrate via the Supabase session pooler
secrets.storage: operator's local .env.local only — not a Vercel production variable
secrets.rotationImpact: db:migrate authentication only — zero impact on the running app

secrets.name: DATABASE_URL
secrets.purpose: alternative full Postgres connection string for npm run db:migrate (takes precedence over SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD)
secrets.storage: operator's local .env.local only — not a Vercel production variable
secrets.rotationImpact: contains the DB password — rotates together with SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD

secrets.name: VERCEL_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Vercel CLI/account API token — tooling only; not referenced by any repo code or CI workflow
secrets.storage: operator's local environment / CI secrets if ever needed
secrets.rotationImpact: CLI/API authentication only — zero impact on the running app

nonSecrets.name: APP_URL
nonSecrets.purpose: canonical origin for OAuth redirects and same-origin checks

nonSecrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
nonSecrets.purpose: Supabase project REST URL — public endpoint, not a credential

nonSecrets.name: GITHUB_CLIENT_ID
nonSecrets.purpose: OAuth client identifier — public by design

nonSecrets.name: SESSION_LEASE_MINUTES
nonSecrets.purpose: inactivity lease length for non-persistent sessions

nonSecrets.name: SESSION_COOKIE_NAME
nonSecrets.purpose: session cookie name override — defaults to dev_ledger_session

nonSecrets.name: SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
nonSecrets.purpose: project ref used to derive the pooler host
